svg.title: See why a file belongs
svg.desc: Replays the website's orbital file map and hover. Same bundled taxonomy Repo, recorded hop placement and import edges. The highlighted editor file is a task Anchor; connected imports remain bright while other included files dim.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: INSPECT THE SLICE / WEBSITE INTERACTION REPLAY

text.font-family: Newsreader, ui-serif, 'Iowan Old Style', Charter, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Hover a file. Its role and connected imports come into focus.
